method: Independent read-only review of committed report, native receipt, three resource journals, terminal result, original CI provenance and build receipt, GitHub run/artifact metadata, D158/D42/D160 records, T24/T51 inventory, and the diagnostic count source. No browser, build, native run, secret access, or product edit.

targets.target: Real admin sign-in and approved organization
targets.evidence: Native receipt records real_admin_signin_and_device_organization pass; guest control showed Scrape visible and Showcase absent before sign-in. The organization diagnostic records admin_role_verified, storage and rendered identity matches, and exactly one visible intended option. The prior D160 auth-completion failure did not recur; this run does not explain that earlier failure.

targets.target: Old A EXIT, ITEM_DETECTED, and RESULT after B starts
targets.evidence: Named native cases passed for A EXIT, A detected, and A result relay rejection while current B remained usable. For detected and result, B extracted three fixture rows in the same tab/document after stamped stale relay.

targets.target: Delayed A cancel and delayed A install
targets.evidence: Both named genuine delayed cases passed with B extracting three rows on the unchanged page; delayed install recorded no obsolete A start.

targets.target: Current B detection, Done/extract, restart, and ordinary page click
targets.evidence: Current B detection relayed, B card/field Done produced three titles/rows, same-page cancel/start had one overlay, and an ordinary page click after cancel registered once. Completion diagnostic separately records Done detach, extraction, repick attach, and cancel detach boundaries.

targets.target: Reinjected content context and exactly one B detection
targets.evidence: Resource-valid native run stopped at lifecycle_B_detection_count_failed after three B rows. Last safe sample: detected_count 2, current_session_detected_count 2, other_session_detected_count 0, producer_current_detected_count 1, install_count 2. A start-world probe saw distinct replacement start/teardown hooks. Post-Done observer reported teardown_distinct false and zero listeners, which cannot by itself prove failed teardown. Two relays versus one producer observation does not establish whether product delivery duplicated an event or the instrumentation observed one twice. Exact listener cleanup remains unverified.

The former untracked-listener tracker exception did not block this run, and prior stale cases advanced. D158 requires the surrounding native reinjection and exact-count criteria, which failed at the count boundary.

Stale relay, delayed cancellation, deferred installation, and current B extraction passed. Reinjection exactly-one detection failed; exact listener cleanup and nonadmin role gating were not established.
Done transfer, restart/repick, and bounded extraction were observed. The run failed before completion of the full reinjection lifecycle and does not promote the inventory case as a whole.

targets.target: EXT-F-1012-T51 seeded fields and nested scope
targets.evidence: Card/title field extraction and repick were observed. Doctor-seeded field preservation, explicit nested outer/alternate scope choices, and page-change behavior in the inventory were not completed by this run.
Guest Showcase absence is a useful control, but it is not a signed-in nonadmin role test.

verdict_B_evidence_quality_privacy.evidence: The committed receipt and journals support the bounded positive cases and a genuine first failed target. Receipt status remains unverified. Its static unverified_criteria list still names stale A channels and delayed cancellation even though named cases passed; use the per-case observations and failure stage, not that list alone. The retained package/browser/acceptance journals end respectively valid exit 0, valid exit 0, and child_failed exit 1 with resourceInvalid false. This is a test/product failure boundary, not resource exhaustion. No native causal localization of the two-relay/one-producer mismatch is present.

The receipt stores bounded booleans/counts/session identities; the reviewer did not inspect credentials. Secret staging/deletion is reported by the worker but not independently verified here.
